issue.title: Complete #xprompt, %directive, and @ref references inside sase run's prompt text
issue.description:
Recorded as deliberately deferred by epic plan sase-oc (plan:202608/cli_completion.md, 'Deferred' section) and filed by that epic's land agent per the discovered-work rule. Also documented for users under docs/completion.md#deferred.

TODAY: 'sase run <TAB>' completes the PROMPT argument as a whole word — native file paths plus stored xprompt names, wired through the RUN_PROMPT_SLOT special case in src/sase/completion/kinds.py and handled explicitly by all three emitters. Completing a reference embedded inside a longer prompt string does nothing.

WANTED: typing 'sase run "do X #co<TAB>"' offers xprompt names, '%<TAB>' offers directives, and '@<TAB>' offers artifact references — the same grammar ACE's prompt input already completes in-TUI.

WHY IT IS NOT SMALL: this is in-word completion, not slot completion. Each shell needs its own current-word introspection (zsh compsys can do it with a custom completer over $words/$CURRENT; bash needs COMP_POINT arithmetic; fish's commandline -ct is the closest), and the candidate sources (xprompt catalog, directive table, artifact index) must stay inside the candidates fast path's import-set and latency contracts. Reuse sase.completion.candidates rather than reaching for ACE's in-process completion code, which imports the forbidden set.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by abb80f44a 'feat(completion): support managed shell distribution': 'Add embedded run-prompt completions for xprompts, directives, and artifact refs across bash, fish, and zsh.' The emitters now ship __sase_run_prompt_fragment/__sase_run_prompt_embedded (emit_zsh_preamble.py:77-132, emit_fish.py:41, bash equivalent), and docs/completion.md:164-168 documents that inside quoted or spaced prompt text '#' completes xprompt names, '%' prompt directives, and '@' canonical artifact references. The item is also gone from the doc's Deferred section. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
